facts.situation: David and Susan Clarke are both retired. Their objectives and circumstances are unchanged since the previous review. Both remain comfortable with risk profile 5 (balanced). They want to simplify their investments and have no current portfolio income requirement. They jointly hold the GIA and individually hold their respective ISAs. Both ISAs are already part-funded for the new tax year. The GIA valuation in the meeting notes is approximate: 'a little over £45,000'.

actions.action: Disinvest the joint Holloway GIA H-GIA-J in full.
actions.amount: Full value of the joint GIA

actions.action: Use the GIA proceeds to top up David's ISA H-ISA-D and Susan's ISA H-ISA-S, split equally between the two ISAs.
